description: This file defines the 'Column' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling table columns in spreadsheets. It includes properties and methods for managing column attributes, such as index, filter button visibility, totals row labels, functions, formulas, and references to the parent table. Additionally, it provides static methods for updating structured references within worksheet cells and named formulas when a table column's title changes.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column in a spreadsheet table, providing methods for managing column properties and updating structured references when column titles change.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Column instance with the specified column index and optional parent table.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index as a string, such as 'A'.

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column index, converting it to uppercase and validating it within the parent table if available.

methods.name: getShowFilterButton
methods.description: Returns whether the filter button is shown for this column.

methods.name: setShowFilterButton
methods.description: Sets whether to show the filter button for this column.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the parent table object this column belongs to.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Assigns a parent table to this column.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferences
methods.description: Static method to update structured references in worksheet cells and named formulae when the table column's title changes.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInCells
methods.description: Private static method to update structured references within individual worksheet cells in a given worksheet.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInNamedFormulae
methods.description: Private static method to update structured references within named formulae in the spreadsheet.
